story.title: The Alchemy of Emotion in Crystal
story.lead: We believe perfume is the most intimate, invisible, yet unforgettable dimension of human beauty.
story.paragraph1: Maison Rayeha unites ancestral Eastern distillation traditions with the meticulous refinement of contemporary Grasse savoir-faire. From aged Cambodian agarwood to harvest-dawn Damascena roses, each botanical is treated with reverence.
story.paragraph2: Every creation matures for months in dark celled cellars, yielding an exquisite concentration that melts into the skin like an intimate personal testament.
story.quote: “A fragrance is an eternal imprint that bends time and renders memories indelible.”

about.metaTitle: The Story of the Maison | Artisanal Alchemy & Heritage
about.metaDescription: The genesis of Maison Rayeha: the meeting of noble Eastern resins, ancient distillation craft, and French haute perfumery.
about.heroTitle: Eternity in Every Drop, Distinction in Every Chord
about.heroSubtitle: We compose fragrance not as mere scent, but as the deepest intangible portrait of identity, memory, and timeless grace.
about.storyTitle: An Alchemical Bridge Between Ancient East and Grasse
about.storyLead: Maison Rayeha was founded on the singular conviction that modern perfumery craves forgotten authenticity.
about.storyParagraph1: In our specialized ateliers, every fragrance takes shape as a handcrafted ode. Through tireless quests across ancient Damask rose valleys, aged sandalwood groves, and remote frankincense plateaus, we transmute nature's rarest gifts into extraits without compromise.
about.storyParagraph2: Slow, patient cold distillation and cellar maturation allow every chord to develop an atmospheric depth impossible in mass-market production.
about.craftsmanshipDesc: Every flacon is hand-filled, wax-sealed, and individually numbered with a master perfumer’s provenance card.
about.rareIngredientsDesc: Uncompromising use of Damask rose harvests, aged natural oud, select saffron filaments, and royal mysore sandalwood.
about.sustainabilityDesc: Ethical harvesting partnerships, recyclable crystal flacons, and 100% plastic-free biodegradable presentation boxes.
about.authenticityDesc: Every bottle carries a verifiable certificate of origin, batch formulation date, and laboratory authenticity seal.
about.processTitle: How Our Fragrances Come to Life
about.processSubtitle: A patient tripartite ritual from earth to crystalline flacon
about.step1Desc: Dawn hand-harvesting of petals followed by gentle alembic steam distillation to preserve the botanical's purest vibration.
about.step2Desc: Harmonizing rare oils followed by 120 days of dark cellar maceration, allowing molecular bonds to reach timeless cohesion.
about.step3Desc: Hand-pouring into heavy-gauge crystal flacons, fitted with micro-mist atomizers and sealed with natural wax.
about.ctaSubtitle: Step into the Maison's curated vault and select the creation that harmonizes with your personal aura.

contact.faq1Q: What is the concentration and longevity of Maison Rayeha creations?
contact.faq1A: All Maison Rayeha creations are formulated as Extrait de Parfum with over 30% pure fragrance oil concentration. This provides 18 to 36 hours of enduring longevity and a refined, atmospheric sillage.
contact.faq2Q: What are the shipping times and delivery terms?
contact.faq2A: Complimentary express delivery is provided for all orders. Shipments arrive within 1–2 business days locally and 3–5 business days internationally in temperature-shielded luxury casing.
contact.faq3Q: What is your return and exchange policy?
contact.faq3A: Each flacon is accompanied by a complimentary 2ml tasting discovery vial. If the wax seal and celophane of the main flacon remain intact, we accept returns within 14 days of delivery.
contact.faq4Q: How do I verify the authenticity of my bottle?
contact.faq4A: Every flacon is individually numbered, hand-inscribed on its provenance card, and sealed with our tamper-evident wax seal verifying batch purity.
contact.faq5Q: Do you offer bespoke gift wrapping and handwritten notes?
contact.faq5A: Every order arrives in a bespoke velvet-lined presentation casket tied with silk ribbon and wax sealed. You may specify a personalized message at checkout for our calligrapher to inscribe.
contact.faq6A: We support all major domestic bank cards via 256-bit encrypted gateway, Cash on Delivery for eligible regions, and Visa/Mastercard/Amex for international orders.
